package.name: tigris_search_planner
package.description: Single-agent TIGRIS (Moon et al., ICRA 2023) informative path planner as an AirStack global planner: a ROS-free C++17 port of the sampling-based tree search (informed sampling, Dubins steering, pruning, original entropy reward or residual-belief reward) run as a receding horizon behind the mtl_msgs SearchMission interface, so the MTL follower and metrics logger fly and score it unchanged.
